test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Fred and George had / bewitched there trunks to fly downstairs to / save the bother of carrying them.

options.text: bewitched there trunks to fly downstairs to
save the bother of carrying them.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "bewitched there trunks to fly downstairs to."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **'there'** is incorrect in this sentence, it should be **'their.'**
